draft.title: Saturn opposite North Node
draft.humanMoment: A harbor authority sets a final clearance date for abandoned fishing sheds as a coastal apprenticeship program prepares to take over the site.
draft.developmentDetail: Former operators seek more time to preserve the sheds, while insurance and repair costs keep rising and the trainees remain without a workshop.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Saturn brings the clearance deadline and mounting costs, while the North Node marks the apprenticeship program as the assignment now demanding space.
draft.aspectMechanic: The opposition places former operators defending the sheds across from trainees waiting for a workshop, so neither the loss of the old site nor the need for its next use can be removed from the outcome.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If the clearance proceeds, the harbor can open the workshop, but preserving the fishing trade will depend on what can be salvaged before the sheds are released.

judge.weakest: If the clearance proceeds, the harbor can open the workshop, but preserving the fishing trade will depend on what can be salvaged before the sheds are released.
judge.why: The consequence is slightly more interpretive than the other fields, but it follows directly from the scene and preserves the tension between release and continuity.
